datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Mali in 2017. Geographic boundaries were mapped with IPC phase classifications (representing food insecurity severity) and compiled into medium-term projection scenarios for February, June, and October 2017.
